name: nookal
description: Access Nookal's allied-health practice management system (patients, cases, treatment notes, appointments, availabilities, invoices) through the myHub-hosted MCP gateway. Single mySMB-held API key shared across every tenant, no OAuth, no per-user credential.

connection.instructions: Nothing to connect — this server authenticates with a single mySMB-held Nookal API key baked into the myHub-hosted MCP gateway's environment, not a per-user credential. To (re)provision the key, generate one in Nookal under Setup > Connections > API Keys and provide it to mySMB ops to register as the NOOKAL_API_KEY secret on myhub-mcp-servers.
